section_summary.extract_value: This section presents inter-scale correlations examining the relationship between acceptance of cosmetic surgery (ACSS) and various measures including General body appreciation, actual-ideal body weight discrepancy, SATAQ-3 subscales, age, and BMI in a Brazilian sample. Results are reported separately for women and men, showing that higher cosmetic surgery acceptance was significantly correlated with lower body appreciation and higher self-reported BMI in both genders, with minor gender differences in SATAQ-3 subscale associations.
